title: Gated correction: selected g v2 applied only if the training-only S3 gate predicts a gain, else C0_refit; every measured DEV dataset with stored rows; retrospective + prospective (TU Delft g v2 from I18-2)
not_done_before: any I18-1 code or S3 value with the g v2 recipe
only pre-check: the existing I7-1 S3 code reproduced the stored S3_f of IHP 300 K fold hv_nmos_W0p3_L0p5 (difference 0)

method.gated: per outer fold f: held-out devices get the correction-arm row if S3_f < 0, else the C0_refit row (S3_f >= 0 or non-finite)
method.unit: one decision per outer fold from the fold's training devices only

gate.S3_f: mean over training records r of fold f of ln(RRMS(r, I_start * exp(g_{-k(r)})) / RRMS(r, I_start)); nanmean (I7-1 run_s3)
gate.g_minus_k: gated arm recipe, seed 0, 500 steps, trained on the fold's training records outside k(r), record load order, applied post hoc (no refit)
gate.sign_convention: S3_f < 0: the reduced correction lowered the starting-card RRMS on inner held-out training records (predicted gain)
gate.threshold: apply iff S3_f < 0 (strict); not fitted (sign used by I8-2 G and I10-2 S_gate)

recipes.g_v2: i12_1_symm.fit_v2, inputs sym_v2, EPS 0.01 V, vdd = dataset supply (sky130 1.85 V, IHP class 1.2 / 3.3 V, TU Delft 1.1 V), lambda = lambda*_f of the outer fold, penalty grids of the inner-training devices (sky130 I12-1 card grids as I15-2; IHP I17_2/pens; TU Delft I18-2 grids), HYPER_V2 with seeds (0,), steps 500; recomputed (S3_v2)
recipes.v1: i3_2_bias.fit_bias, S3_HYPER (seed 0, 500 steps); stored values used

sky130_77K.s3: S3_v2 new, records I13_1/records, lambda*_f I15_2/decision.json lambda_star

ihp_300K.s3: S3_v2 new, records I5_1/start/records_300K, lambda*_f I17_2/inner/inner.json

tudelft_4K.s3: S3_v2 new on I18-2 state-C records, lambda*_f I18-2 inner

tudelft_295K.s3: S3_v2 new on I18-2 state-C records, lambda*_f I18-2 inner

fallback_tudelft: if I18-2 is invalid or its selected rows are missing: I6-1 stored rows (M_bias v1, C0_refit, clamp state L) and stored I7-1 S3_f, labelled fallback

rules.stat: per dataset GMR(gated, C0_refit), i3_2_bias.paired_ratio, 10000 resamples, seed 0, 95% percentile CI, unit per dataset
rules.C1_never_worse: CI lower <= 1 on every primary dataset

validity.V1: finite paired rows: sky130 18, nist_4K 53, nist_rt_card_4K 87, ihp 18 per temperature, tudelft 45 per temperature; g v2 rows equal stored selected_rows (difference 0)
validity.V2: I18-1 S3 code with the v1 recipe reproduces stored I7-1 S3_f of IHP 300 K folds hv_nmos_W0p3_L0p5 and lv_nmos_W0p15_L0p18 within 1e-9
validity.V3: finite S3_v2_f on every outer fold of sky130, ihp_300K, tudelft_4K, tudelft_295K; every inner fit ran

reported: GMR(gated, C0_refit) under the other unit (device for TU Delft, geometry cluster for IHP)
v1 gate on every dataset with v1 rows: sky130 all-18 state C (S3_v1 new on I13_1/records), NIST x2, IHP x4, TU Delft x2 (I6-1 stored, state L)
S3_v2_f vs S3_v1_f per fold (sky130, IHP 300 K); within-dataset Spearman(S3_f, y_f)
equal-weight pooled exp(mean ln GMR); per-dataset oracle (post hoc)
known_before: v1-arm datasets fully known (S3_f, decisions, rows; I8-2 fold gate, I10-2 S_gate); sky130 and IHP 300 K g v2 rows known, S3_v2 not computed; TU Delft g v2 rows not computed (prospective)
order: prereg (alone) -> code + unit tests -> smoke (2 folds, 50 steps) -> I18-2 prereg (alone) -> I18-2 code -> queue I18_1_s3, I18-2 jobs, I18_1_s3_tud, I18_1_decide
